quest.title: Exploding Population
quest.description: The Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have posted a special commission...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: We've recently received a commission from the Fishing Association, claiming that the fish activity in the nearby waters has been abnormal.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, their report does not mention any specifics. Could you help us check in on the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I have full faith that no matter what the problem is, you will overcome it with ease.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fishing Association? Is it that fishing?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Huh? "That fishing"? I'm not sure I understand... Is there any other kind of fishing to speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, the Fishing Association... The Fishing Association... Sure sounds like they're in the business of catching delicious fish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, there's no time to lose — let's go check this out! Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: The fish have been really active these days...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need help?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Yes, and here comes my help now, I suppose! Good day to you!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Ahem. My name is Nantuck, senior fisherman of the Mondstadt Fishing Association.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Recently, many new fish species have suddenly appeared in nearby waters.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: I immediately contacted my friends in other regions, and sure enough, this has been happening everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Some people say that this must be the Teyvat fish outbreak of the century!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Actually, the reason hasn't been fully investigated, but I guess it has something to do with the improvement of the ecological environment...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you guys are in trouble because there are too many fish, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon will take care of it! As long as they don't taste bad...

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Haha, it's no trouble. In fact, the more fish, the better as far as the Fishing Association is concerned. However, we need enough manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: And to be honest, with the manpower we have available...

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: We'd be hard-pressed to catch all the new fish species for research in a short time.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: But on the flip side, I thought, isn't this also a great opportunity for the Fishing Association to grow?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: So I put up a commission with the Adventurers' Guild. Well, how about it? Interested in joining us?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Fishing is a lot of fun, you know!

choices.text: No problem, I'm good at fishing.

response.speaker: Nantuck
response.text: Great, what an energetic youngster you are!

response.speaker: Nantuck
response.text: So... Let's start by going to Cider Lake.

response.speaker: Nantuck
response.text: That's where the fishing grounds I prepared for newcomers is. I'll teach you the basics first.

choices.text: Can I just go down and catch them straight?

response.speaker: Nantuck
response.text: Isn't it really dangerous to dive straight in? You adventurers sure are bold...

response.speaker: Nantuck
response.text: Unfortunately, those fish are not as brave as you. All of them will be scared away if they see such a huge being jump into the water.

response.speaker: Nantuck
response.text: Best you refrain from doing such a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: This place will do! See those little fish in the water? They're so beautiful...

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Here, take some of these tools. We have fishing rods, bait, and formulas for making bait.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: First, place the bait on the hook, then aim for where the fish are gathering... then cast your rod! Then, dutifully wait for the fish to take the bait.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: I've heard that newcomers have something called "beginner's luck." I caught a large bass that was more than half a meter long back then! Well, go on then, give it a go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's to catching another Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You shall have no other Paimon before this Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Paimon? What a strange name, is it a kind of fish?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a sort of "wonderous seafood" that I managed to catch last time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! When did Paimon go from "emergency food" to "wondrous seafood"!?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Ah, I see! I didn't realize that you were already an experienced angler.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Well, that just makes me even more excited to see what you'll catch!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: How did it go? By the look on your face, I suppose you got a pretty good haul! Let me see.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Oh? It's a newly discovered species of fish! That's wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: You're almost catching up with me back when I was in my glory days, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you also catch fish with your bare hands?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Ahem... Seems like these ordinary little fish are a walk in the park for you. I should consider giving you something more challenging...

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: You might not know this, but even fish from the same species can have huge differences between individuals because of differences in living environment and food.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Even though they all look the same, some individuals are particularly active and energetic. They jump out of the water from time to time and are very eye-catching.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: These individuals are superior by far in terms of both commercial and aesthetic value.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Many hobbyists buy them at high prices and keep them at home in their tanks for ornamental purposes. This is why such fish are also called "ornamental fish."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that means, apart from "Emergency Paimon"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's also "Ornamental Paimon"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, there isn't! How can there be so many kinds of Paimons!?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Yes, that's precisely how it works. Looks like you've gotten it already!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Recently, there have been many "ornamental fish" active in the waters near the Stormbearer Mountains, which I have marked on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Let's go over and check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: How did it go? By the look on your face, I suppose you got a pretty good haul! Let me see.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Oh? It's a newly discovered species of fish! Most stupendous... Hey, wait, what's that other fish in your bag?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Wow— That's amazing! Do you know what this is? It's an "ornamental fish"!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: You might not know this, but even fish from the same species can have huge differences between individuals because of differences in living environment and food.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Even though they all look the same, some individuals are particularly active and energetic. They jump out of the water from time to time and are very eye-catching.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: These individuals are superior by far in terms of both commercial and aesthetic value.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Many hobbyists buy them at high prices and keep them at home in their tanks for ornamental purposes.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: This one in your bag is a true-blue "ornamental fish."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that means, apart from "Emergency Paimon"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's also "Ornamental Paimon"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, there isn't! How can there be so many kinds of Paimons!?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Yes, that's precisely how it works. Looks like you've gotten it already!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry I underestimated you before... no! I underestimated the elites of the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Guess I should hurry up and put up more commissions. I have got to attract talent like you to join the Fishing Association, if that's the last thing I do!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: By the way, if you need fishing gear in the future, you can drop by our Fishing Association to have a look. Our prices are very affordable!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Hehe, not to brag or anything, but we do have a good collection of fine goods!

talks.objective: Catch an Ornamental Fish in the Stormbearer Mountains

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Back so soon, youngster? You're pretty quick, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Let me take a look... Wow! This one here is a true-blue "ornamental fish"!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Y—You're definitely a first-class angler!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry, it seems like I underestimated you before... No! I underestimated the elites of the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Guess I should hurry up and put up more commissions. I've got to attract talent like you to join the Fishing Association, if that's the last thing I do!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: By the way, if you need fishing gear in the future, you can just swing by our Fishing Association to have a look. Our prices are pretty reasonable!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Hehe, not to brag or anything, but we do have a good collection of fine goods!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Let's go over and check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Start once you're ready. I'm looking forward to seeing what you might catch!
